q.g: In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs on Woods without wearing any armor vest or armored chest rig. Armored headwear, face cover and eyewear is allowed. If you want to protect yourself during this quest you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a Scav. To keep yourself safe while doing this quest, you should try and remain as far away as possible from the Scavs and consider using a scoped weapon.
